summary: Independently re-verified all four T16-final-review findings are genuinely closed by T20 and that closing them changed nothing else. Self-enumerated all four emitTerminalState call sites (agent.ts:1235/1517/1668/1684) and wrote a new assertion-bearing probe (T21-terminal-reason-probe.ts) proving the no-progress stop now reports "no_progress" (not "budget_exhausted") while the round-budget, tool-call-budget, and ask_user stops still report their own distinct reasons -- the preserved T16-final C11 case only recorded this without asserting it. Verified the TerminalStateReason union widening breaks no consumer: exactly 3 files reference the type, no exhaustive switch or persisted-value comparison exists anywhere in src/, and sac/catch-up.ts's readTerminalState does a blind unvalidated JSON.parse cast, so an older-build value still reads correctly. Proved the new regression genuinely depends on the production change by copying src/ into a scratch directory outside the working tree, reverting only the one production line there, and running the exact unmodified committed test against that copy -- it fails with Expected "no_progress" / Received "budget_exhausted", while the three untouched genuine-reason paths still pass. Independently traced every return/continue exit from the runAgentTurnCore for(;;) loop body (abort/cancel, reset, no-progress, entry-guard stop) to confirm the deleted trailing round-ceiling guard was genuinely dead, rather than accepting the stated reasoning. Reran both preserved probe files unchanged (15/15 pass), the focused 3-file suite (111 pass/0 fail), both TypeScript targets (exit 0), and targeted ESLint (clean). No new blocker, major, or minor finding.
summary_markdown: All four `T16-final-review.md` findings are confirmed genuinely closed, with independent, self-executed evidence rather than the implementer's word. **F-001 (major)**: wrote a new hard-assertion probe (`T21-terminal-reason-probe.ts`) proving the unattended no-progress stop now emits `TerminalState.reason="no_progress"` (not `"budget_exhausted"`) while 16/20 rounds and 47/50 calls remain unspent -- the preserved `C11` case only *recorded* this, it never asserted it. All four `emitTerminalState` call sites were re-enumerated directly (not trusted from T20's count) and the other three (round-budget, tool-call-budget, `ask_user`) confirmed still correct by dedicated probe cases. **Union widening**: `TerminalStateReason` has exactly 3 references in `src/`, no exhaustive switch/persisted comparison exists anywhere, and the one real disk-persistence consumer (`sac/catch-up.ts`) does a blind unvalidated `JSON.parse` cast -- an older-build value reads through untouched. **Regression genuinely depends on the fix**: copied `src/` into a scratch directory OUTSIDE the working tree, reverted ONLY the one production line there, and ran the *exact, byte-for-byte unmodified* committed regression against that copy -- it fails (`Expected: "no_progress" / Received: "budget_exhausted"`), while the three untouched paths (F-002/F-003 doc fixes don't affect behavior; the other three terminal reasons) stay green. **F-004**: traced every `return`/`continue` exit from the loop body myself (abort, cancel, reset, no-progress) rather than accepting the dead-code claim -- confirmed the deleted trailing guard's only reachable position (a successful round falling through) is re-caught by the entry guard on the very next iteration. Verification: both preserved probe files 15/15 pass unchanged, focused suite 111 pass/0 fail, both TypeScript targets exit 0, targeted ESLint clean on all 4 T20-changed files. Stage 2 (code quality): no findings.
